name: photo-riso-poster
title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成一张安静的孔版印刷档案海报
tagline_zh: 照片太吵？它把可见事实拆成计数、间距、遮挡、方向、色彩角色，再用 2–3 色油墨和证据型排版重组成一张温度匹配的纸。
tagline_en: Too noisy? It deconstructs counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles, then rebuilds them as a 2–3 ink.
desc_en: Turn a photo or a text theme into one quiet riso-print archive poster. For a photo, deconstruct its observable facts (counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles) and rebuild them as a sparse 2–3 ink risograph composition on temperature-matched paper, with typography that also carries the evidence; for a text theme, distill one imageable idea. Aspect ratio follows the source photo. Generate
why_zh: 不是滤镜，是分析。它把照片的客观事实变成构图语法，油墨和纸张温度都按证据选择，排版也承载数据——每根线。
why_en: Not a filter—an analysis. It turns observable facts into compositional grammar, with ink and paper temperature chosen by.
limit_zh: 只接受单张照片或一个文字主题；输出是静态海报，不生成多页或动效。需要本地有 Python 3.9+ 和 riso 相关。
limit_en: Single photo or one text theme only; outputs a static poster, no multi-page or motion. Requires Python 3.9+ and riso libs (pypdf, Pillow); no.
title_en: Distill a photo into one quiet riso-print archive poster
